title: Mixed Event — Picture Perfect! — Episode7 That's A Wrap!

meta.Event Outline: When Kamiyama High School's very first Arts Festival is announced, Class 2-A decides to produce a film! It falls to Nene to sit in the director's chair, but will her leadership cut it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This is it. Our final day...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(We shoot the climax today.
Our film hangs on how this fight scene goes.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We need to make our hero look as good as we can as he does everything he can to save the girl...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks. Actors, are you all ready...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You gave us the acting pointers we needed, so we should be good to go now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Dark Cook A
rows.Line:
“Ah, there you are, Wandering Cook!
The food you're carrying will be ours this time!”

rows.Speaker: Wandering Cook
rows.Line:
“What quarrel do you have with us?!
You already have more than enough food!”

rows.Speaker: Dark Cook B
rows.Line: “All of the food in this world belongs to the Dark Culinary Society...”

rows.Speaker: Dark Cook C
rows.Line: “Those who stand in our way are to be dealt with, including you!”

rows.Speaker: Wandering Cook
rows.Line:
“Oh, for the love of...
I will feed all those who are in need.”

rows.Speaker: Dark Cook A
rows.Line: “Enough talk! This is the end of the line for you! Everyone, get him!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Here we go...!
The three goons attack the Wandering Cook all at once.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He dodges the first one's punch and grabs his arm... He did it pretty well during practice...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(The problem is the next part...
He has to use the arm of the first guy to throw him into the second while spinning to dodge the third's attack...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Shinonome practiced this part a lot while listening to Soda's instructions, but...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He even got the cape to wave around and look really cool...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Cut! Show me what we just took!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The footage looks good. The action feels real...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I don't believe it.
Even Soda said this stunt would be really hard, but you managed to pull it off in one take.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We did practice it a ton with that in mind...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But we're not done yet...
And we don't have time, so we gotta keep going.

rows.Speaker: Wandering Cook
rows.Line: “I'll have no choice but to go all out if you still refuse to surrender.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(We're at the ending...
We're actually going to finish...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (That last fight scene was the hard part.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (All we have to do now is the standard moves. These guys come at me, and I make them collapse by landing hits on the backs of their necks...)

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Please, stop...
You can have our food, so please stop hurting him!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(That isn't in the script...
Is she ad-libbing...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Shinonome really nailed those last stunts, so everyone's on a roll...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can see why she wants to keep going...)

rows.Speaker: Wandering Cook
rows.Line:
“No...!
That food is meant for your mother.”

rows.Speaker: Wandering Cook
rows.Line:
“I'm a cook...
My purpose in life is to make the best food I can for those who need it...”

rows.Speaker: Wandering Cook
rows.Line: “I don't care how hard it's going to be for me to do that. I'm not giving up...!”

rows.Speaker: Wandering Cook
rows.Line: “I wasn't planning on bringing any cooking utensils into this fight...”

rows.Speaker: Wandering Cook
rows.Line: “I've been using these ladles for a very long time. I know them well. I've also learned that if a cook takes good care of their utensils, they can do...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I checked the footage we shot today, and it all looked good.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We did it...!
Great work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Thank goodness. We made it to the end.

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line: Yeah... I wasn't sure what was gonna happen after I got hurt, but I'm so glad we managed to get our film over the line...

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line: I wish I could've been in the climax, but I can't wait to show our film to the kids at my dojo...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Really...?
I'm glad you feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line:
Hehe...
We were able to finish because our director did such an amazing job.

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line:
When Soda got injured...
You told us not to give up. And I'm really glad you did.

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: What she said. We get to celebrate now because you made the right call.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
So, Kusanagi, thanks a ton!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, I should be the one thanking all of you.
I mean...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: From my point of view, you were the ones who made our film a reality. I was able to do my job as the director because of all your guys' hard work.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Our camera crew, costume designers, actors... Everyone. We all made this happen together.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, the way Shiraishi and everyone improvised back there was so impressive. I couldn't help but feel moved by your performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We're done shooting, but we still have to edit it... That being said, I have a really good feeling about our film. So, everyone, once again...
